finalText:
Fixed the buried error in `src/core/settings.js`. Line 17 was using an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`, and there was no fallback constant. The fix: added `retries: 1` to DEFAULTS and changed `maxRetries: retries` to `maxRetries: env.retries || DEFAULTS.retries`.

Build now finishes clean with the 3 warnings still present but the 1 error gone. Exit code 0.
